Geometry: pdftotext -bbox-layout, every word rectangle compared against its own page's width and height. Pixels: pdftoppm -r <dpi> -gray writing PGM P5, parsed byte for byte by a P5 reader written in this lane that refuses any magic other than P5 and any maxval other than 255; no PNG was read anywhere and there is no RGB-as-grayscale path in it. Every raster was deleted in the same shell call that measured it; none was retained.
